name: open-yixiancard
description: Open-YiXianCard 原作证据驱动的弈仙牌战斗模拟、遥测与分析工作台

scripts.release:site: bun run build:site && bun run check:release
scripts.check:ui: bun run check:public-surface && bun run check:rust:ui-card-catalog && bun run test:ui && bun run smoke:ui && bun run audit:ui
scripts.check: bun run check:bun-version && bun run check:public-surface && bun run check:rust:ui-card-catalog && tsc -p jsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:rust:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path engine-rust/Cargo.toml --lib && bun scripts/check-rust-wasm.ts
